# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository manages event description documents for Azure AI Developers Community (JP) to be published on connpass.

## General
- Write and edit content in Japanese unless a section is explicitly in English.
- Keep tone professional, friendly, and community-oriented.
- Preserve existing structure, headings, and formatting unless the task requires changes.
- Avoid unnecessary reformatting; make minimal, targeted edits.

## Content Guidelines
- Ensure dates, times, locations, and URLs are accurate and consistent.
- Use concise, clear language appropriate for event announcements.
- Maintain consistency in speaker names, titles, and affiliations across sections.
- Always include an anti-harassment policy section in event pages.
- When adding lists or tables, follow existing Markdown style in the file.

## Formatting
- Use Markdown headings and tables as currently used in the docs.
- Keep line breaks and spacing consistent with the surrounding content.
- Do not introduce HTML unless the file already uses it for images/embeds.

## Safety and Compliance
- Do not include confidential or personal data beyond what is already provided for public event pages.
- Respect copyright for images and external content; only link to authorized resources.
